origin.description: Distribution function of the Cramer-von Mises distribution.
origin.details: Four terms of the Anderson-Darling series. A term is dropped when (4k+1)^2/(16q) exceeds -log(eps).

translation.description: Distribution function of the Cramer-von Mises distribution.
translation.details: Four terms of the Anderson-Darling series. A term is dropped when (4k+1)^2/(16q) exceeds -log(eps). The modified Bessel function of the second kind is scipy.special.kv with order 1/4.
translation.value: The distribution function at each quantile.
translation.example: q = np.array([1e-4, 0.005, 0.00543, 0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 0.461, 1, 2, 10, 100]); vals = np.concatenate((pcramer(q), pcramer(q, eps=1e-8))); print(" ".join(format(float(v), ".17g") for v in vals))
